description: Regional festivals for Assam and Northeast India shopkeepers

events.name: Rongali Bihu (Assam NY)
events.stock_hint: Pitha (rice cake ingredients), Coconut, Jaggery, Gamosa (towel), New clothes — biggest Assam festival

events.name: Bhogali Bihu (Harvest)
events.stock_hint: Pitha ingredients, Til, Coconut, Gur, Rice — harvest feast

events.name: Christmas (NE — Christian)
events.stock_hint: Cakes, Plum cake, Chocolates, Decorations — Meghalaya/Nagaland large Christian

events.name: Durga Puja (Assam)
events.stock_hint: New clothes, Sweets, Puja items — Assam celebrates like Bengal

events.name: Eid (Assam)
events.stock_hint: Sewai, Dates, Biryani spices — Assam has sizable Muslim community
